errors.evidence: The description does not explain what each numbered line represents, i.e., it omits the descriptions from the legend (e.g., Line 1 is 'Städtische Regionen, Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser'). It only provides numerical references 'Linie 1', 'Linie 2', etc.
The marker for line 1 is an asterisk (*), not an 'x'.
Line 4 does not rise to 21% in the period 2015-2017; it fluctuates around this value, having already been above it in 2014. The description of the trend is inaccurate.
Line 5 (dotted green) starts at approximately 11.5% in 1984. It is line 6 (solid green) that starts at around 9%. The description confuses the starting values of lines 5 and 6.
